guard: a Jcode once seat starts a fresh session and never lists or attaches a session an earlier seat of the same name left in its home
why: A seat's Jcode home is keyed by space and name, so a once seat lands where an earlier seat of the
same name ran, and the host resumes the largest session it finds there (#789). For a once seat
that session is an earlier seat's, and its task and history reached the new task's model. F1
drops the once branch, so the host lists the home's sessions and attaches the earlier one.

mutations.name: F1 a once seat resumes the session an earlier same-name seat left
mutations.expectRed: the seat never lists its home's sessions, and creates its own instead of attaching the earlier one
